text_block_list.text: A little before the All Comers...

Ikuno Dictus and I were having a strategy 
meeting for the All Comers.
choice_data_list:
—Those are the points of concern we need 
to watch out for as of now.

—Those are the points of concern we need 
to watch out for as of now.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. ...That was so much 
information, I felt a bit overwhelmed.
choice_data_list: Well, I had some free time.

text_block_list.text:
While Ikuno Dictus was helping Twin Turbo, 
I busied myself gathering data on the 
competing Umamusume alongside "IRON WILL"—

"I've created simulations for every 
conceivable development that could occur 
in the All Comers."

Everything was done to let Ikuno Dictus 
win the All Comers.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ......I am deeply grateful.
choice_data_list:
Let's fine-tune our countermeasures more 
in the remaining time.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...It's going to be a tough race, for 
sure.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I must do everything within my power to 
face it in peak condition—"

...The light in Ikuno Dictus's eyes is 
firmly fixed on victory. That much was 
unmistakably clear to me.
The day of the All Comers had arrived—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much again for all your help 
with this. Thanks to you, Turbo and I can 
both compete for victory with everything 
we've got."
choice_data_list: I didn't really do anything special.

text_block_list.text:
As Ikuno Dictus's trainer, I respected her 
will and did everything I could so she 
could face the race in peak condition.

It was nothing more than that. Everything 
she accomplished beyond that was a result 
of her own choices and hard work.
choice_data_list: ...Do you think you can beat Twin Turbo?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: As long as it goes according to plan.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, defying all expectations is 
just the kind of Umamusume Twin Turbo is."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I will not let my guard down until the 
very end. ...Naturally, against the other 
runners as well.
choice_data_list:
Looks like today will be a great 
experience

Looks like today will be a great 
experience, huh?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. I think so too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: How long do you intend to stay like that?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...It's none of your business anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to wallow in dejection and 
waste your time in vain, that is your 
choice.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haha... That's rough—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Having your path cut short by an 
injury. I truly sympathize with how you 
must feel. However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it a bit premature... to give up on 
everything?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ……I know that, even I do.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...It's not like I gave up from the 
beginning.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Right after I got injured, I was totally 
like, "I'm gonna heal this up in a flash!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd make it in time for the 
Kikuka Sho... I believed I could heal much 
faster than this...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even though... I tried so hard... I just 
didn't recover the way I hoped...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Forget the Kikuka Sho... They're telling 
me it might even be tough to run again 
this year...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Where did I even push past my limit? 
Before I knew it—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Moving forward without knowing what lies 
ahead... My legs... my heart... they're 
feeling so heavy—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
......No matter how far I proceed, there 
is no light. If anything, my vision only 
grows darker—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Thinking 'If it means going 
somewhere even darker,' one might want to 
stop their exhausted legs."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However, please do not forget.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That in this world... there are still 
those who refuse to give up and keep 
striving forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And... that there is someone who believes 
you can do it too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
“—Hello, McQueen? Did you find Teio? Turbo 
and the others are about to enter the 
paddock, though—”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That voice—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san is with me right now. So please, 
don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Teio-san, do you remember?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
About the person you pushed away the other 
day, telling them, 'I'm not running 
anymore.'

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Do you remember what she told you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...'I'll completely leave them in the 
dust and win the All-Comer, no matter 
what.'"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"‘That's why’... ‘don't you dare talk 
about giving up’..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Running in today's All Comers is Ikuno 
Dictus-san, whom I fiercely competed 
against in the Spring Senior Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This will likely be an extremely tough 
race for Twin Turbo-san. However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"She hasn't given up in the slightest on 
you returning to the turf."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I face this race to fulfill what I 
promised you, and to show what it truly 
means to 'never give up.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Myself, Nature, and Tannhauser, who aided 
in Ms. Turbo's fight, have likewise not 
given up on you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...And as for Ikuno-san, who faces off 
against Turbo-san today, she worries for 
the future with a broader perspective than 
anyone else."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She's not giving up on you, who stopped 
running... nor on Turbo-san, who's trying 
to run for your sake. She refuses to give 
up on either of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even though Turbo-san was supposed to be 
her rival, she sacrificed her own time to 
help polish her running—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she's trying to surpass that 
running style and win in a fair, head-on 
fight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To make today's All Comers a fair and 
wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To make this a race that reaches your 
heart...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone gave it their absolute all today 
to show you what it means to 'never give 
up.'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Won't you please watch? Today's 'All 
Comers'."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What you choose to do after seeing this... 
I will no longer meddle in.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ――To think it would be this much...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...Such tremendous concentration, it's 
enough to give me a cold sweat...—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Turbo-san is planning to run to her 
absolute limit today for Teio-san's 
sake...)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (This is absolute conviction.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Today... will be a magnificent race.
